reasoning_traces.think:
The sitemap analysis forms a hierarchical probabilistic model where sitemaps are clusters and individual URLs are observations. The key challenge is accounting for heterogeneity in server response times and error rates. By treating status codes as outcomes of a Bernoulli trial (reachable vs. not), we can derive uncertainty intervals using Wald-type approximations or better, Wilson score intervals. This also allows us to flag sitemaps with unusually high 404 rates as potential configuration errors or content removals.
